note: Recurring cast (spec §5, OPEN_QUESTIONS #3, #5). Names and biographies are placeholders for the owner to replace. 'friend' and 'parent' are resolved per campaign. Ids of players are the ids used on the field. `roles` name the teammates the story arc leans on (striker, organiser, keeper, newcomer): arc content addresses them by role so shared scenes read the same in both campaigns while still pointing at real roster identities. `school` lists the classmates the Story Engine v2 school hub uses: `rival` is the classmate who plays for a rival club (friend in class, opponent on Saturday), `teacher` runs the classroom activities, and the shared classmates fill recess games.

shared.name: Coach Code
shared.bio: Strict, loud, passionate, demanding, detail-oriented and compassionate; funny; listens; admits mistakes; no grudges when players leave.

shared.name: Coach Delgado
shared.bio: Sonoran United U12 head coach and the club's recruiter. Polished, persuasive, promises more than the roster can hold.
